data.top: When AI gets the answer WRONG

lines.text: AI got it wrong. [1] Now watch every layer blame each other.
Maastaaru! AI has billions of numbers inside. How does it know which one messed up?
Easy, Chintu. The same way India finds out who lost the match.
Last ball! India needs six to win! [1] He swings, [2] and he's caught on the boundary!
Oh no! Whose fault is this?
Start at the result, [1] and walk backwards. [2] The batsman takes the most blame. [3] The captain who changed the batting order takes some. [4] And the selectors, a little.
Backpropagation does exactly this inside AI. [1] The error flows backward, layer by layer, [2] and every connection gets blamed by how much it contributed.
A fair review, from the third umpire!

data.yes: Blame by contribution, then fix a little

lines.text: So everyone doesn't get the same blame?
No! [1] Blame by contribution. [2] Then each weight fixes itself, just a little.
गलती कहीं भी हो, मैं पीछे जाकर पकड़ लूँगा!
lines.show: Galti kahin bhi ho, main peeche jaakar pakad loonga!
lines.sub: Wherever the mistake is, I'll go back and catch it!

lines.text: Repeat this blame and fix, [1] millions of times, and the mistakes keep shrinking.

data.question: In backprop, which layer gets blamed FIRST?

lines.text: Quick test! Which layer gets blamed first? [1] Three seconds. <pause 3> [2] The last layer! Blame starts at the answer, and flows backward.

data.label: Blame smartly. Fix a little. Repeat.

lines.text: So AI learns by... blaming smartly?
